Dialogs.Dialog: I'm still not really used to this...
It's not like I hate it.
I see, so that's how it feels...
Why do you look so happy？ You're making me smile too.
Geez... you really love this, huh？ Dummy♪
Aren't you turning into more and more of a dirty old man？
Hey... Never mind, it's nothing. Just stay like that.
Yeah, yeah, are you satisfied？ Your face says not yet, though.
Look how happy you are. What a goofy face♪ Hehe.
At this rate, we're just a pair of lovey-dovey idiots.
Maybe I'll fight back too？ Like, take that!
Getting happy over something like this is so dumb. Well, I'm no better.
You wanna get even more lovey-dovey？ Hmm, what should I do？
You're the only one who makes me feel like this. You know that, right？
You really like me, huh？ Alright, alright.
Quit looking at me like that. It's... kinda embarrassing.
Did you think this would make me happy？ Well, you're not wrong.
That's embarrassing... Not that I mind.
I still don't know what I'm supposed to say.
What do you wanna do？ Go on, tell me.
Again？ Guess I have no choice.
Clinging to me like that again...
This is all we ever do, huh？
You wanna be all over me even more, right？
Maybe I'll rub my cheek against yours.
Well... I think I like it.
Your face is way redder than mine.
It's only okay because it's you.
I said no... Okay, just a little.
Eek! I'm gonna pinch that hand.
Hehe, I told you no, didn't I？
Stuff like this actually feels nice.
Are you trying to spoil me？
My hair's pretty special, you know？
A little more... might be nice.
I closed my eyes for a second.
I think I'm getting a little used to it.
So, what are you gonna do next？
Geez, I'm making an exception here...
Do you have a thing for ears？ ...Geez.
Hey... that was way too sudden.
Wait... I told you not to.
Nngh! ...I was just a little surprised, that's all.
Don't look so happy about it.
Is it because you like me？
Linking arms really makes us feel like a couple, huh.
It's nice, linking arms like this.
You're gonna make me wanna nuzzle up to you.
You can hold me even tighter, you know？
I don't wanna let go anymore.
I hope my hands aren't cold.
I'm nervous, so my hands might get sweaty.
Do you want to lace our fingers together？
Holding hands... I think I like it.
Here, I'll lend it to you.
Don't think we'll ever let go now, huh？ Hehe.
What are you trying to do with my hand？
Holding hands lightly is nice too, isn't it？
My heart is pounding so hard now.
It's embarrassing... I can't look at you.
You can stroke it more, you know？
Can I touch your cheek too？
Want to press our cheeks together？
Eek... I thought my heart was gonna stop.
It tickles, but... I think it feels nice.
Did it look sexy or something？
Couldn't keep your hands to yourself？ Hehe.
Is the nape of my neck really that great？
That feels pretty nice, you know？
I'm not sure how to put it...
Does that make you want to touch me more？
What're you gonna do if it becomes a habit？
Was there dust on me or something？
Huh？ Was there something on me？
Eek! That made my back straighten right up...
When all I do is read, I end up slouching before I know it.
All right, you fix your posture too!
What？ You're touching me in a weird way...
My back？ You want to touch it？
Huh？ Oh, I thought you were calling me.
I can't see what you're doing, so... it makes me nervous.
Are you having fun with this or something？
It feels weird... Not in a bad way, though.
I think I like it when you're casual about it.
Do I have a troubled look on my face？
Geez, the way you're moving your hand is weird.
Is that another way of showing affection？
Hey, why are you getting so carried away？
Maybe I should pinch that hand of yours？
Ah! Mmm, I'll put up with it for you.
If you want me to kick you, just say the word, okay？
So you really are a dirty old man？
Who said you could touch me there？
I'm about to kick you on reflex...
Touching me too much is a little...
Well, I won't force you to stop.
So, does this mean our relationship is progressing？
How long do you want me to put up with this？
You want Rinko to pay attention to you？
Um, what was I talking about again？
So, back to what I was saying.
Geez, now I lost my train of thought.
Can I finish what I was saying？
